what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the Niger in Cameroon: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9489 Nigerien asylum seekers in Cameroon, 43.8% of all asylum seekers from the Niger.
Refugees from the Niger, a separate group, live mostly in Mali, Nigeria, Benin and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in the Niger from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of the Niger with the MNJ in 2007 and 2008 and with JNIM from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2011 at 5 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Cameroon.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Cameroon only.
